general_exclusion_criteria:
Poor performance status (ECOG >= 2).
Inadequate marrow function (absolute neutrophil count < 1.5 x 10^9/L, platelets < 100,000/uL, or hemoglobin < 9 g/dL).
Liver dysfunction (total bilirubin > 1.5 mg/dL or AST/ALT > 2.5 x institutional ULN).
Renal dysfunction (creatinine clearance rate < 50 mL/min).
Coagulopathy (INR > 1.5 or partial thromboplastin time > 1.5 x ULN without anticoagulation).
Elevated creatine phosphokinase (> 2.5 x ULN).
Poor cardiac function (left ventricular ejection fraction < 50% or baseline QTc interval >= 480 ms).
Active brain metastases or known carcinomatous meningitis.
History of glaucoma, retinal vein occlusion, or other significant ocular pathology.
History of rhabdomyolysis or neuromuscular disorders associated with elevated CK.
Uncontrolled intercurrent illness (including uncontrolled hypertension, unstable angina pectoris, uncontrolled cardiac arrhythmia, congestive heart failure NYHA Class III or IV, active ischemic heart disease, myocardial infarction within the previous six months, syncope of cardiovascular etiology, ventricular arrhythmia, uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, severe obstructive pulmonary disease, or severe chronic liver or renal disease).
History of a second malignancy (unless disease-free for 5 years, or cervical cancer in situ or non-melanoma skin cancer diagnosed and treated within 5 years and recurrence-free for 1 year).
Allergic reactions to study drugs or their components.
HIV positive with history of AIDS-defining opportunistic infection within the past 12 months or requiring strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers.
Active hepatitis B virus or hepatitis C virus infection.
Exposure to strong CYP3A4 inhibitors or inducers.
Pregnancy or breastfeeding.
Inability to swallow oral medications or impaired gastrointestinal absorption (e.g., gastrectomy, Crohn's disease, ulcerative colitis, or baseline Grade 2 or higher diarrhea).
Active systemic bacterial or fungal infection requiring intravenous antibiotics or antifungals.
Severe acute respiratory syndrome from coronavirus 2 (SARS-Cov2) infection <= 28 days prior to first dose.
Treatment with warfarin.
Other serious or uncontrolled preexisting medical conditions (e.g., interstitial lung disease, severe dyspnea at rest or requiring oxygen therapy).
